## `pygeovision.monitoring.site_tracker`

pygeovision.monitoring.site_tracker ===================================== Multi-epoch site tracking via connected-component extraction, spatial identity matching, and a standard constant-velocity Kalman filter — for quantifying expansion/contraction rates of discrete disturbance sites (e.g. mining pits, deforestation patches) across a time series of per-epoch classification/change maps.

| Name | Kind | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `Site` | class | A single connected-component disturbance site at one epoch. |
| `extract_sites` | function | Connected-component extraction of individual disturbance sites from a binary mask (e.g. a thresholded mining-probability map). |
| `match_sites_across_epochs` | function | Track site identity across epochs via spatial (IoU) overlap. |
| `KalmanTrackResult` | class |  |
| `KalmanAreaTracker` | class | Standard constant-velocity Kalman filter applied to a site's per-epoch area measurements. |
| `classify_site_activity` | function | Classify a site's final estimated rate into expanding / stable / recovering. |
| `track_and_classify_sites` | function | End-to-end: extract sites at every epoch, match identities across epochs, Kalman-filter each site's area trajectory, and classify. |
